title: Microsoft Teams: Android device management moves to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing passes: its migration dates, access requirements and four portal controls are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge the transition guide's conflicting FAQ, avoid promising automatic updates for end-of-life devices, and remove checklist instructions for controls absent from the table.
